limitations: SWE-chat has no prompt-injection or benignity adjudication, so this is review-load evidence rather than a false-positive rate.
The source is opt-in public open-source traffic and is not representative of proprietary or enterprise coding-agent use.
A large fraction of the source comes from Entire.io repositories.
Only the earliest non-continuation human prompt is assessed; later turns, tool returns, and code are excluded.
Source-side and local privacy screens reduce exposure but cannot prove that every retained public prompt is free of personal data.
No source text was sent to OpenRouter or retained in the result artifacts.
The panel is development evidence and must not select a threshold or model after opening.
purpose: prospectively frozen traffic-like direct-user local cascade diagnostic
